inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.deliveryDateHint: Resolves vintage and device age rules
inventory.asOfHint: The lot as it was effective at a time, as recorded at another (bitemporal).
inventory.splitHint: Of {{quantity}}; the rest stays in a second lot.
inventory.cancelHint: Cancels the certificates for a consumer; the registry instruction is created separately.
inventory.withdrawHint: Removes the lot from inventory, e.g. after a registry correction. It cannot be undone here.

purposes.ON_BEHALF_OF_THIRD_PARTY: On behalf of a third party

inventory.allowancesHint: Allowance balances by registry account. Choose a holding to see its movements and to preselect it for a movement or a transfer.

ops.reserveHint: Earmarks the certificates so that allocation and transfers leave them alone. A part of the lot is split off first.
ops.releaseHint: Releases reservation {{ref}}; the certificates become free for allocation and transfers again. If an allocation plan made it, the plan no longer holds them.
ops.correctHint: Corrects what a registry may correct in place: expiry, support, labels and cost. Other attributes need a replacement lot.

movement.title: Record movement

ladder.title: Expiry ladder
ladder.hint: Held and reserved MWh by month of expiry, next {{months}} months

journal.broken: These lots' journal chains do not verify

form.deliveriesHint: Each delivery: its production window, the delivery date and the quantity.
form.newLead: Capture a GoO or EUA trade. It goes to middle office for approval.
form.amendLead: Change the terms. The amendment becomes a new version of the trade.

ops.recordHint: Records a delivery made outside the registry flows. Use the registry instructions where they apply.

ops.noDocuments: No documents yet: issue our confirmation to create one.
ops.noObligationsHint: Confirmed trades open their deliveries here, earliest first.

trades.noValuationHint: Choose another date, or wait for the official valuation run of this one.

allocation.noObligationsHint: Confirmed sales open obligations; disclosures and own use are opened here.

admin.countriesHint: ISO country codes, two letters each

admin.bucketCriterionFixed: The criterion stays as defined ({{summary}}); retire the bucket and create a new one to change it.
admin.changeRequestsDescription: Sensitive master data changes waiting for, or decided by, a second person.
admin.accountingPolicyNote: The accounting policy changes through month end, approved by a second person.
admin.counterpartySensitiveNote: Registry and bank accounts change through requests a second person approves; credit limits are risk limits.
admin.blankKeeps: A cleared field keeps its stored value.
admin.obligationsOpenAt: Delivery obligations open when a trade is

admin.gsrnHint: 18 digits, the last a GS1 check digit

admin.asOfHint: The record as it was known at this time

admin.noRequestsHint: Changes to registry integration, counterparty registry accounts and bank accounts are requested from reference data and appear here until a second person decides.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.description: Deliveries to invoice and invoices of {{entity}}
settlement.priceFixed: Price fixed; the items were evaluated again
settlement.itemResolved: The item is open for invoicing
settlement.runHint: Drafts one sales invoice per counterparty and currency for open items delivered up to the date. Drafts are submitted for a second person's approval.
settlement.purchaseHint: A supplier's invoice is matched to our open purchases from that supplier; net and VAT must agree with them within 0.05. It is issued after a second person approves it.
settlement.noOpenPurchases: No open purchases from this supplier in this currency
settlement.chooseSupplier: Choose the supplier to see its open purchases
settlement.purchaseRegistered: Purchase invoice registered as a draft
settlement.amountsHint: Amounts and VAT are computed by the server from the deliveries and the approved VAT rules.
settlement.frozenAtIssue: Details are frozen from reference data when the invoice is issued
settlement.discardHint: Its deliveries become open again and can be invoiced later.
settlement.creditNoteHint: Drafts a credit note that reverses the invoice in full. It is issued after a second person approves it.
settlement.allocateAmountHint: Empty: as much as the invoice still owes
settlement.bankReferenceHint: Recording the same reference again returns the earlier payment
settlement.cancelNettingHint: The invoices stay open and can be netted or paid again.
settlement.counterpartyRefHint: How the counterparty confirmed the statement, e.g. their e-mail or document number
settlement.importPaymentsHint: One payment per line: bank_reference,value_date,amount,currency[,counterparty,remittance]. A negative amount is a payment we made. Lines imported before are skipped.
settlement.legalTextHint: Printed on invoices, e.g. the reverse-charge reference
settlement.netPaymentHint: An unapplied payment of {{amount}} with this counterparty

nettingDirections.even: The invoices offset exactly; nothing is paid

settlement.nettingSettled: Netting settled; the invoices are paid
settlement.nettingValueDateHint: Invoices due by this date are netted
settlement.noIntraEuSales: No sales to businesses in other member states in this period
settlement.noNetPayment: No unapplied payment fits; record the payment first
settlement.noOpenInvoices: No open invoices fit this payment
settlement.nothingIssued: No invoices issued in this period
settlement.nothingToPay: Nothing is paid: the invoices offset exactly.
settlement.ownNetting: You prepared this statement, so someone else records the counterparty's agreement.
settlement.paysInvoicesHint: Empty: invoice numbers found in the remittance text are paid; the rest stays unapplied
settlement.prepareNettingHint: Nets every issued, unpaid invoice with the counterparty in the currency, due by the value date. The counterparty's agreement is recorded by another person.
settlement.proposeRuleHint: A new rule, or a new version of an existing code. It applies only after another accountant approves it in the inbox; items waiting for it are evaluated again then.
settlement.recordPaymentHint: A payment from the bank. It is applied to the invoices you choose, or to invoice numbers in the remittance text.

noItems.attention: Nothing needs attention: every delivery is priced and has a VAT rule
noItems.open: No open items: every delivery is invoiced
noItems.all: No settlement items yet; they appear when deliveries are recorded

registry.title: Registry
registry.description: Registry instructions of {{entity}}, transfer routes and statement formats
registry.transferHint: Moves certificates to another account. A part of a lot is split off first. The transfer waits for a second person's approval in the inbox before it is sent.
registry.noRoute: No route on record between these registries; the registry decides whether it can be done.
registry.routeFeasible: Route available: fee {{fee}} per MWh, about {{days}} days
registry.routeInfeasible: These registries cannot transfer to each other.
registry.transferSubmitted: Transfer submitted; it waits for approval
registry.routesHint: Used by the allocation engine to score sources, and shown before manual transfers.
registry.formatsHint: How each registry's statement and transaction exports are read.
registry.cancelHint: A lot in transfer is released; reserved allowances are given back.
registry.failHint: The registry refused the instruction or it cannot be completed. It can be retried or cancelled afterwards.
registry.confirmHint: Record this only when the registry shows the transaction as completed.
registry.formatEditorHint: The column mapping names the column header for each statement field; the server checks the fields against the kind. Registry * makes a profile usable for every registry.
registry.cancellationHint: Cancels the certificates in the registry for a beneficiary. The instruction waits for a second person's approval in the inbox; the lot leaves our books when the registry confirms it.
registry.cancellationSubmitted: Cancellation submitted; it waits for approval
registry.beneficiaryIdHint: Optional, e.g. a business ID or metering point
registry.allowanceTransferHint: Moves allowances to another account in the same registry. They are reserved at once; the transfer waits for a second person's approval and is then carried out in the registry.
registry.allowanceTransferSubmitted: Allowance transfer submitted; it waits for approval
registry.noFreeAllowances: This account has no free allowances.

kpi.openHint: Not yet confirmed by the registry
kpi.pendingHint: A second person decides in the inbox
kpi.attentionHint: Failed, or the outcome is unknown

registry.emptyHint: Transfers, cancellations and surrenders appear here once they are submitted.
registry.relatedTasksHint: The approval and any follow-up in the inbox.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Registry statements against the books of {{entity}}

types.MISSING_INTERNALLY: In the registry, not in our books
types.MISSING_IN_REGISTRY: In our books, not in the registry

reconciliation.subject: Certificates or balance
reconciliation.uploadHoldingsHint: The account's holdings as the registry exports them. It is read with the registry's statement format, then reconciled at once: new differences become breaks, and breaks the registry no longer shows clear themselves.
reconciliation.uploadTransactionsHint: A registry's transaction export: open instructions it shows as completed are confirmed, failed ones are failed. It affects every legal entity, so it needs access to all of them.
reconciliation.transactionResult: {{lines}} lines: {{confirmed}} confirmed, {{failed}} failed, {{final}} already final, {{unmatched}} unmatched
reconciliation.noBreaks: No breaks: the registry agrees with our books.

typeHints.MISSING_INTERNALLY: The registry shows certificates we have no lot for: record them as received, or accept the difference.
typeHints.MISSING_IN_REGISTRY: We hold certificates the registry no longer shows: confirm the transfer that took them, withdraw our lot, or accept the difference.
typeHints.ATTRIBUTE_MISMATCH: Our lot describes the certificates differently: correct the correctable fields, replace the lot with the registry's version, or accept the difference.
typeHints.BALANCE_MISMATCH: Our allowance balance differs from the registry's: book the difference as a correction, or accept it.

reconciliation.awaitingAcceptance: {{by}} asked to accept this break as it is; another person decides in the inbox.
reconciliation.confirmInstructionHint: The registry executed the transfer that holds these certificates; it is confirmed and the lot leaves our books.
reconciliation.withdrawHint: The certificates are no longer ours in the registry; the missing range is split off and withdrawn.
reconciliation.correctHoldingHint: Books the difference between the registry's balance and ours as a correction movement.
reconciliation.acceptHint: The difference stays in our books as it is, with your reason. A second person approves it in the inbox.
reconciliation.acceptanceRequested: Acceptance requested; it waits for a second person
reconciliation.receiptHint: The certificates as the registry shows them become a lot of ours on this account.
reconciliation.replaceHint: Our lot is withdrawn and replaced by a lot with the registry's attributes.
reconciliation.notReconciled: This statement has been imported but not reconciled yet.
reconciliation.noBreaksHint: A break appears when a registry statement differs from our books.
reconciliation.noStatements: No statements for this account yet
reconciliation.detailsHint: The differences the reconciliation recorded for this break.

confirmations.title: Confirmations
confirmations.description: Counterparty confirmations of {{entity}}'s trades, matched against ours
confirmations.hint: A confirmation that differs from ours opens a task: a second middle or back office user overrides it (the trade is confirmed) or disputes it.
confirmations.uploadHint: One line per delivery: confirmation_ref, our_trade_ref or counterparty_trade_ref, trade_date, product_family, product, quantity, unit, price, currency, delivery_date, and optionally amount, payment_date, seller_name, buyer_name, seller_lei, buyer_lei, seller_account, buyer_account. Lines with the same confirmation_ref form one confirmation.
confirmations.enterHint: Starts from our terms. Enter what the counterparty's confirmation states; it is matched against ours when you save it.

received.MISMATCHED: Received; it differs from ours and waits for a decision
received.RECEIVED: Received; it is matched when ours is issued

confirmations.mismatchHint: Their terms differ from ours. A second person overrides the differences (the trade is confirmed) or disputes the confirmation in the inbox.

kpi.mismatchedHint: Waiting for a second person's decision

confirmations.emptyHint: Counterparty confirmations arrive by CSV upload or are entered on the trade.
confirmations.comparisonHint: Field by field, with the matcher's verdict on each.
confirmations.termsHint: The terms as we issued them.

login.title: Sign in to the demo
login.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.aboutPersonas: After signing in you act as one of the personas (trader, middle office, back office, accountant, risk, auditor, admin) and can switch at any time from the top right. Approvals need a second person, so switch to the second persona of the same role to approve.
login.aboutShared: The data is shared: other visitors see what you change.
login.aboutReset: Everything is reset to the example portfolio every night.
login.aboutFictitious: All companies, counterparties, devices, registries and prices are fictitious.
login.access: Ask the person who shared this demo with you for the sign-in details.

demo.resetHint: You return to the sign-in page when the new data is ready.

demo.notShowcase: Only the public demo (showcase profile) can be reset. Here, drop the database to start over.
